title: 船不開了
subject: three friends stuck on Green Island for two extra days under a cloudless sky when the ferries stop for swells from a typhoon far out at sea
caption: Mandarin Afropop on a South African amapiano groove. A deep percussive log drum bass playing syncopated slides; a laid-back house kick with off-beat shakers and wood-block percussion; jazzy Rhodes electric piano chords; a soft breathy flute-like synth pad answering the vocal; light congas. Spacious sunny mix, round warm low end, crisp light percussion. Male baritone, relaxed and half-spoken in the verses, with a soft female harmony on the chorus. 113 BPM, A-flat major. Sun-dazed, lazy and quietly gleeful. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no reggaeton dembow, no straight four-on-the-floor jazz-house groove, no rap verse.
lyrics:
[Intro - log drum and shakers]

[Verse 1]
早上九點 碼頭的鐵門拉下來
公告上寫 浪太大 今天停航
天空藍到 一片雲都沒有
颱風在好遠的海上 我們根本看不到

[Pre-Chorus]
小美打給老闆 聲音裝得好可憐
阿哲已經跑去 機車多租一天

[Chorus - Female Harmony]
船不開了 船不開了
回不去了 沒辦法嘛
再一碗海草冰 再住一晚民宿
船不開了 大家不要急

[Verse 2]
傍晚去泡 海邊的溫泉
梅花鹿在路邊 盯著我們的便當
手機說 明天浪還是一樣
我們三個 忍不住一直笑

[Pre-Chorus]
老闆傳來一句 好啦好啦
回來記得 帶伴手禮

[Chorus - Female Harmony]
船不開了 船還是不開
回不去了 好可惜喔
再一碗海草冰 再數一晚星星
船不開了 大家不要急

[Outro - log drum and shakers fading]
第三天 船開了
我們在碼頭 走得好慢
